scope_note: Corrective primary-source audit adds current Andale parcel assessment, contractor-reported campus floor area, and two recipient- or government-reported Meta community grants. The search trail records useful and negative results across identity, tax, construction, jobs, suppliers, utilities, water, permits, public costs, incentives, community funding, and county comparison inputs. Campus-wide facts remain unallocated to the selected inventory building, overlapping community amounts are not added together, and unavailable supplier, payroll, utility-billing, discharge, generator, and marginal-service-cost amounts remain explicit gaps.

sources.title: Meta 2025 Environmental Data Index
sources.notes: Facility tables report Forest City electricity consumption of 535,555 MWh, water withdrawal of 16 megaliters, zero market-based Scope 2 emissions and 144,104 metric tons CO2e of location-based Scope 2 emissions for 2024. Values are rounded to whole displayed units and the methodology permits utility, meter, design-estimate or proxy inputs where applicable. Only electricity is normalized as a canonical source record because the shared evidence metric registry lacks compatible annual water-withdrawal and facility-emissions definitions.

sources.title: Investing in American manufacturing to build the infrastructure for AI
sources.notes: Meta describes a multiyear agreement with Corning worth up to $6 billion for U.S. data-center optical infrastructure and a Corning expansion in Hickory, North Carolina. The source does not allocate contract value, purchases, employment, or production to the Forest City campus or Rutherford County, so no quantitative project supplier record is created.

sources.title: Our Data Center Opens in Forest City, N.C.
sources.notes: Meta reports that Building 1 broke ground in November 2010 and opened on April 19, 2012, while Building 2 was expected later in 2012. The page identifies a multi-building campus but does not allocate facts to the inventory building footprint.

sources.title: North Carolina Brownfields Program 2012 Annual Report - Andale
sources.publisher: North Carolina Department of Environment and Natural Resources
sources.notes: The Andale row identifies four Old Caroleen Road addresses, approximately 153 acres, former Burlington Industries use, VOC contamination, and planned data-center redevelopment under a February 3, 2012 brownfields agreement.

sources.title: Rutherford County EnerGov parcel layer - ANDALE LLC query
sources.notes: The exact owner query returned parcels 54822, 54821, 54708 and 62150 at 284 Social Circle, 0 Old Caroleen Road, 0 Social Circle and 408 Social Circle. Their displayed acreages sum to 153.11 and their land-plus-building Total_Property_Value fields sum to $273,242,300; the layer does not date the assessment cycle or expose personal-property values.

sources.title: Meta, Forest City Campus
sources.notes: The project profile identifies Meta as client, Forest City as location, and 789,000 square feet as project scope. It does not define occupied area, data-hall area, current utilization, construction cost, payroll, or the selected inventory building's share.

sources.title: Facebook Forest City Data Center
sources.notes: DPR describes two 370,000-square-foot buildings, four data suites per building, and 90% local-workforce participation for both buildings. It provides no worker count, work duration, payroll, supplier spend, contract value, or current-campus completeness statement.

sources.title: Public Access to Building Permits
sources.publisher: Town of Forest City, North Carolina
sources.notes: The town page links a public monthly-issued-permit folder and provides a records contact. Searches of the indexed portal and linked public folder did not yield a reliably project-matched permit value, generator schedule, or completion record for Andale, Meta, Facebook, 284 Social Circle or 408 Social Circle.

sources.title: North Carolina Division of Air Quality Permitted Facilities
sources.publisher: North Carolina Division of Air Quality
sources.notes: The inventory identifies Andale, Inc., facility 8100221, 284 Social Circle, permit 10165R03, issued April 15, 2019, and Synthetic Minor classification. The inventory does not report generator count, nameplate capacity, runtime, fuel use, emissions, or operating cost.

sources.title: North Carolina Utilities Commission Orders and Decisions Issued in 2012
sources.notes: A Duke rate-case order lists Facebook Forest City among North Carolina data centers billed on tariff OPT-H and gives a combined-customer off-peak share. It provides no Forest City-specific load, demand, bill, tariff rider, interconnection cost, rate impact, or customer-level usage amount.

sources.title: Water Treatment
sources.publisher: Town of Forest City, North Carolina
sources.notes: The town reports an 8 MGD treatment capability, Second Broad River source and 2.7 million gallons of elevated storage. The page contains no Meta/Andale customer withdrawal, consumption, billing, capacity reservation, incremental cost, or rate-impact amount.

sources.title: Wastewater Treatment
sources.publisher: Town of Forest City, North Carolina
sources.notes: The town reports 4.95 MGD design capacity and 1.25 MGD current system flow. It does not publish a Meta/Andale discharge volume, customer bill, pretreatment load, service cost, or capacity allocation.

sources.title: Important Notice: Repeal of Exemptions for Electricity Used at Datacenters
sources.notes: The notice describes qualifying and eligible internet datacenter exemptions and the 2026 repeal of the electricity exemption. It does not identify Forest City or disclose taxpayer-level exempt purchases, forgone revenue, compliance filings, or refund amounts.

sources.title: Rutherford County FY2025-2026 Budget Message
sources.notes: The adopted-budget materials were reviewed for project-attributable public safety, infrastructure, tax-administration, water, or other service costs. No same-scope marginal annual cost for Meta/Andale was located.

sources.title: Isothermal Community College partners with Meta to create high-tech lab
sources.notes: The grant recipient reports a Meta grant of more than $250,000 for an Extended Reality and Artificial Intelligence Lab serving Polk and Rutherford counties and explicitly connects the partnership to Meta's Forest City Data Center community activity.

sources.title: Town of Forest City Annual Financial Report for the Year Ended June 30, 2025
sources.publisher: Town of Forest City, North Carolina
sources.notes: The audited supplementary schedule reports a $300,000 Meta Grant (BARN), all received in prior years, for the Park Square Depot capital project. The report also shows a $5,070,136 FY2025 economic-development incentive expenditure but does not name its recipient, so that line is not encoded as a Meta record.

sources.title: BEA API for Data Retrieval User Guide
sources.notes: The guide documents county GDP and income tables used by the governed 2001-2024 county panel. County aggregates do not identify Meta, isolate the campus, or establish a causal project effect.

sources.title: QCEW Searchable Databases
sources.notes: The portal provides county employment and wage histories used by the governed comparison panel. Published county-industry aggregates do not disclose a Meta establishment payroll or support causal attribution to the Forest City campus.

sources.title: County Business Patterns Data
sources.notes: County Business Patterns provides county-industry establishments, employment and payroll. Employer confidentiality and county aggregation prevent a project-specific Meta payroll, supplier-spend, or operating-headcount observation.

project_updates.title: Identity and opening chronology search completed
project_updates.notes: Search family: operator facility and chronology. Query/identifier: Meta Forest City opening, Building 1, Building 2; date range 2010-2012. Documents inspected: Meta opening page and current Forest City factsheet. Result: useful - confirms operator, multi-building campus, November 2010 groundbreaking, April 19, 2012 Building 1 opening and planned 2012 Building 2; no building-to-inventory allocation was published.
project_updates.project_description: Meta's Forest City Data Center is a multi-building hyperscale campus operated by Meta in Rutherford County, North Carolina; the inventory project is one mapped building within that campus, while most public evidence is campus-wide and unallocated. Meta broke ground in November 2010, opened Building 1 on April 19, 2012, and expected Building 2 later in 2012 on the redeveloped Andale brownfield property. Contractor profiles describe two 370,000-square-foot buildings and a 789,000-square-foot campus program, and public records document later building work, four Andale-owned parcels, town water infrastructure, community grants, and facility-level resource reporting.

project_updates.title: Brownfield land and boundary search completed
project_updates.notes: Search family: state brownfields and land records. Query/identifier: Andale, project 14036-10-081, 1181/1185/1271/1291 Old Caroleen Road; date range 2010-2024. Documents inspected: 2012 Brownfields Annual Report, NCDEQ success story, finalized inventory and land-use-restriction update. Result: useful - former industrial use, contamination, agreement date and approximately 153-acre redevelopment boundary; no allocation to the selected building.

project_updates.title: Assessor parcel and ownership search completed
project_updates.notes: Search family: county assessor/GIS. Query/identifier: UPPER(Property_Owner) LIKE '%ANDALE%' on EnerGov Parcel layer 3, with ParcelID, address, acreage, land, building and total-value fields. Date range: current snapshot queried September 6, 2026. Documents inspected: four returned parcel rows 54822, 54821, 54708 and 62150. Result: useful - 153.11 acres and $273,242,300 real-property value; negative for a dated assessment cycle, personal property, or a single-building allocation.

Documents inspected: Rutherford County ACFRs for fiscal years 2021 through 2025 and their taxpayer tables/notes.
